remarks:
FREE GAS + 50 ACRES — Exceptional private estate offering a rare combination of luxury living, extensive acreage, and premium amenities. The property features multiple ponds, landscaped gardens, a 40×60 pole barn, and a second garage with full attic storage.

The residence welcomes you with soaring wood ceilings and a grand stone fireplace. The chef’s kitchen includes premium appliances, custom cabinetry, and an oversized island. The main-level primary suite offers a spa-inspired bathroom, a spacious walk-in closet, and scenic views. A second primary suite with a private bath provides ideal accommodations for guests. Two additional first-floor bedrooms and a full bath offer added convenience, along with an oversized laundry room and abundant storage throughout.

Additional interior features include a fenced pet area and an elevator providing easy access between levels.

Outdoor amenities create a true resort-style experience, including a heated swimming pool, expansive patio, multiple seating areas, a custom shade awning, and a built-in stone grill—perfect for entertaining or relaxing in total privacy.

This property offers an unparalleled blend of comfort, craftsmanship, and natural beauty, making it a one-of-a-kind opportunity, close to Chautauqua Institution and Chautauqua Lake!  Listing agent is a relative of the Estate.  Make sure to view the video for the full scoop of the property!
